KANCITY — NEWLY PRODUCED CONTENT
(System Output — Second Generation Run)
========================================

ACT ONE: THE ARRIVAL
FADE IN:
EXT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS - DAY.
A new academic year begins, bringing a fresh start for campus life.
Kan, a freshman, arrives.
Fresh ambitions emerge on the bustling campus.
He feels immense excitement and a strong sense of belonging here.
His friends gained admission earlier, and Kan was the final one accepted.
His good mood does not last.
Kan loses his wallet.
It holds cash and a phone number, his only link home.
He realizes that his wallet is gone.
His friend calls, reporting strangers have the wallet. His friend then gives him a contact number.
Kan is new to campus. He knows little of its streets or people. He stays near his hostel.
The wallet holds money.
After lectures, he calls.
A voice tells him to come outside school premises to collect it.
At 5 p.m., he goes.

ACT TWO: THE INITIATION
EXT. OFF-CAMPUS LOCATION - LATE AFTERNOON.
He finds a group.
More than seven men sit there.
They are drinking.
They wave him over and offer him a seat.
Kan takes the seat.
They tell him to drink.
He says no.
The mood turns.
He knows refusal is not an option.
He drinks.
He tries to leave for his hostel.
This moment entangles him with the Viking Confraternity.
This group is feared. It is a cult in the state, one of the country's deadliest.
Kan does not know.
One man is EMK, their executioner.

ACT THREE: THE CONSEQUENCE
EXT. OFF-CAMPUS LOCATION - NIGHT.
Kan's situation changed, becoming dangerous with no clear escape.
His life changed irrevocably.
This encounter marks his initiation into a world of hidden power, a place demanding loyalty and severe consequences.
His choices now determine a path from which there is absolutely no return.
FADE OUT.
